from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialStatementRow(BaseModel):
    """Extracted net profit data from a single financial report."""
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    fiscal_year: str = Field(description="The fiscal year the report covers (e.g. '2023')")
    net_profit_label: str = Field(description="The line-item label used in the document (e.g. 'Net Income', 'Net Profit')")
    net_profit_value: str = Field(description="The numerical value of the net profit as written in the document")
    currency_scale: str = Field(description="The currency or scale indicated (e.g. '$', 'thousands')")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim excerpt containing the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_statements: list[FinancialStatementRow]
